Verify DICOM PACS Connectivity (C-ECHO SCU)

Source: R/network.R
dicom_echo.Rd

Performs a DICOM Upper Layer A-ASSOCIATE-RQ handshake followed by a Verification SOP Class (1.2.840.10008.1.1) C-ECHO-RQ over TCP, or verifies a local directory-backed PACS connection.

Usage

dicom_echo(
  x,
  port = 104L,
  called_ae = "ANY-SCP",
  calling_ae = "DICOMTK",
  timeout_ms = 5000L
)

Arguments

x

A "dicom_connection" object from dicom_connect() or a hostname string.

port

Integer port (used if x is a hostname string). Default is 104L.

called_ae

Called AE Title. Default is "ANY-SCP".

calling_ae

Calling AE Title. Default is "DICOMTK".

timeout_ms

Timeout in milliseconds. Default is 5000L.

Value

A tibble::tibble with columns host, port, called_ae, success, status, message, and elapsed_ms.

Examples

conn <- dicom_connect(local_dir = system.file("extdata", package = "dicomtk"))
dicom_echo(conn)
#> # A tibble: 1 × 7
#>   host       port called_ae success status        message             elapsed_ms
#>   <chr>     <int> <chr>     <lgl>   <chr>         <chr>                    <dbl>
#> 1 127.0.0.1   104 ANY-SCP   TRUE    SUCCESS_LOCAL Local DICOM reposi…        0.1
